input.args: which endpoints does Marketing Cloud Growth expose for sending events?

input.description: Scrape Marketing Cloud Growth references area

result:
Marketing Cloud Growth doesn't expose dedicated "event" endpoints in its published API references. The platform provides the following data ingestion capabilities instead:

## REST APIs for single-record operations:
- **`POST /services/data/v63.0/sobjects/contact`** ([createContact](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/marketing-cloud-growth/references/mc-rest-contacts?meta=createContact)) – Create individual contact records
- **`POST /services/data/v63.0/sobjects/lead`** ([createLead](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/marketing-cloud-growth/references/mc-rest-leads?meta=createLead)) – Create individual lead records

## Bulk APIs for high-volume ingestion:
- **Contacts Bulk API 2.0** ([mc-bulk-contacts](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/marketing-cloud-growth/references/mc-bulk-contacts)) – Bulk contact ingestion via job-based upload
- **Leads Bulk API 2.0** ([mc-bulk-leads](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/marketing-cloud-growth/references/mc-bulk-leads)) – Bulk lead ingestion via job-based upload

## Other APIs:
- **Briefs REST API** ([mc-rest-briefs](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/marketing-cloud-growth/references/mc-rest-briefs)) – Marketing brief management
- **Segments REST/Connect APIs** – Segment management, not event ingestion
- **Identity Resolution Connect API** – Identity ruleset management, not event ingestion

If you're looking for traditional event/behavioral tracking endpoints (page views, clicks, custom activities), Marketing Cloud Growth doesn't publish those in its DSC references. The platform focuses on contact/lead data management rather than real-time event streams.
